ننطبع (form VII)
# نَنْطَبِعُ (nanṭabiʕu) /nan.tˤa.bi.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# نَنْطَبِعَ (nanṭabiʕa) /nan.tˤa.bi.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
# نَنْطَبِعْ (nanṭabiʕ) /nan.tˤa.biʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْطَبَعَ (inṭabaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
